title: Built to benefit everyone: our plan
fallback_text: Built-in search excerpt from the official OpenAI page. Authors: Sam Altman and Jakub Pachocki. title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
fallback_text: Built-in search excerpt from the official OpenAI page. The partnership covers stateful developer environments, enterprise agents, custom models for Amazon developers, Bedrock distribution, and large-scale Trainium infrastructure. Sam Altman, OpenAI co-founder and CEO, says AI should show up in ways that are practical and genuinely useful for people. The agreement includes next-generation Trainium capacity intended to support increasingly capable AI systems and production-scale agent applications.
